# [TASK] Setup Gradle Multi-Module Build

## Task
Configure the root Gradle multi-module build wiring together all 9
backend modules (8 services + shared-library): Java toolchain, Spring
Boot/Spring Cloud dependency management, and test coverage, shared from
one root build.

## Parent Story
Parent: #83

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] All 9 modules (8 services + shared-library) recognized by a single root Gradle build
- [x] Java 25 toolchain + Spring Boot/Spring Cloud dependency management configured at the root, inherited by every module
- [x] JaCoco coverage reporting wired into every module
- [x] Shared-library importable from every service module
- [x] `./gradlew build` completed successfully across all modules (verified 2025-11-14)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 5
